case_order: eligible manifest IDs sorted; rotate left by replica*floor(count/3); shard into at most 16; reverse each second shard
noise_control: native function plus projection for paired; native projection versus itself for Spark-only
ratio: Spark increment/native increment only when native increment is positive and above its A/A floor
oversize_policy: No row downsampling or changed shapes. Planning/execution errors, 300-second preflight timeout or memory cap are explicit exclusions. Five-row sliding frames bound window list/string outputs. A timed case failure leaves that function untimable and continues the remaining original schedule without reruns.
